collection.cost_definition: single-GPU pipeline wall time, including loading, CPU tools and grading; not kernel-active time

candidate.cost_definition: single-GPU pipeline wall time, including loading, CPU tools and grading; not kernel-active time

evaluation.cost_definition: single-GPU pipeline wall time, including loading, CPU tools and grading; not kernel-active time

timeline.interpretation: Calendar span covers formal collection, candidate training and evaluation controllers; gaps include audits, publication or idle time. Neither gaps nor phase wall time measure GPU kernel-active time or billing.

limitations: Only six repository clusters and short authored faults: confidence intervals are limited evidence and do not establish general coding or long-task ability. Three repeats are not 180 independent tasks. Extra system compute is not reported as parameter gain.
